title: Aaj Hai Shere Khuda Moula Ali ka Matam
body:
Aaj hai shere khuda moula Ali ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
Rote hai aj zameen…..
Rote hai aj zameen…..
Arshe bari louho qalam
Uth gaya saya jo hasnain key sar se haaye
Gham mein moula key aza…..
Gham mein moula key azadarao ki aankhe hai nam
<<MINI>>
Aaj hai shere khuda moula Ali ka matam…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Tham kar sar ko tadap te hai Ali har lamha
Fatima zehra key ab…..
Fatima zehra key ab, ghar mein ajab hai alaam
<<MINI>>
Aaj hai shere khuda moula Ali ka matam…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab ko bulwa key Ali apne qareen rote hai
Ek koone mein hai aaa…..
Ek koone mein hai Abbas kiye nazre qam
<<MINI>>
Aaj hai shere khuda moula Ali ka matam…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghash pe ghash aata hai moula ko ajab mehshar hai
Do sada baba hame…..
Do sada baba hamein, lab pe bayan hai paiham
<<MINI>>
Aaj hai shere khuda moula Ali ka matam…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghoonjti thi aye sohail arsh pe harsu ye Fughan
Sar pe haider key khuda…..
Sar pe haider key khuda, hogaya kaisa ye sitam
<<MINI>>
Aaj hai shere khuda moula Ali ka matam…..
